generations.prompt: Close-up, 85 mm lens, shallow depth of field, late afternoon low golden sun from the side. An older woman with grey hair tied back in a dark field jacket kneels at the dark earth wall of a deep excavation trench and scrapes carefully at the wall with a small pointed trowel held in a blue nitrile-gloved hand, her lined face calm and concentrated, a smear of dark mud on one cheek; fine dust drifts in the light; the wall is soft behind her. She does not look at the camera and does not speak. Camera is fixed, no camera movement. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
